recipes.name: Our own recipes
recipes.description: Dishes such as idli, dosa, upma and kheer are not in the sources above. We calculate them from a recipe: raw ingredient weights (from the sources above) plus the weight of the cooked dish. The maths is done by tested code, never by AI. A recipe shows "values being checked" until a person has reviewed it.

notes: Values are per 100 g. Carbs are digestible carbohydrate; fibre is shown separately.
Foods marked "values being checked" are still being reviewed against a second source.
Household measures: 1 katori = 150 ml and 1 glass = 250 ml; piece and spoon weights come from USDA's measured portions.
